gui.essentialcraft5.ultra_heat_generator.en: Output depends only on the heat, which rises while it burns:
gui.essentialcraft5.ultra_heat_generator.zh: 产量只看温度，烧燃料时温度不断升高：

gui.essentialcraft5.ultra_heat_generator.en: above that: 72 + heat ÷ 1000 MRU per tick.
gui.essentialcraft5.ultra_heat_generator.zh: 再往上：每刻 72 + 温度 ÷ 1000 MRU。

gui.essentialcraft5.ultra_heat_generator.en: The four blocks two steps away (N, S, E, W) only set how fast it heats up.
gui.essentialcraft5.ultra_heat_generator.zh: 东南西北相隔一格的四个方块只决定升温快慢。

gui.essentialcraft5.ultra_heat_generator.en: The heat never drops, but is lost when the generator is broken.
gui.essentialcraft5.ultra_heat_generator.zh: 温度不会降，拆掉就归零。

gui.essentialcraft5.ultra_natural_furnac.en: Put flowers, leaves, grass or logs in the slot to burn them,
gui.essentialcraft5.ultra_natural_furnac.zh: 把花、树叶、草或原木放进格子里烧，

gui.essentialcraft5.ultra_natural_furnac.en: one at a time; each makes MRU while it burns.
gui.essentialcraft5.ultra_natural_furnac.zh: 一次烧一件，燃烧期间持续产出 MRU。

gui.essentialcraft5.ultra_natural_furnac.en: Logs burn the longest and give the most.
gui.essentialcraft5.ultra_natural_furnac.zh: 原木烧得最久、产得最多。
